# MotionGrid Technologies

> MotionGrid Technologies is a South African bespoke software agency. We design, build, and maintain custom software platforms — from client portals and field-service tools to applied AI features — engineered for precision, performance, and longevity.

## Company

MotionGrid Technologies Pty(ltd) builds bespoke software for businesses across plumbing, fleet maintenance, panel beating, logistics, healthcare, retail, and applied AI. Founded and run by two engineers (Prince Ncube, Engineering Lead; Mnqobi Ntuli, Product Lead), we take products from first conversation to deployment. We work with a modern stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, and React, with AI features layered where they add real value.
